<div class="type-signature"><span class="modifiers">public final class </span><span class="element-name type-name-label">ElectronicHorizonDataLoader</span>

 <p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behaviors. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.
 <p>Offline availability: This property is available online and offline.</div>

<div class="block"><p>Creates a new instance of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-electronichorizondataloader" title="class in com.here.sdk.electronichorizon"><code>ElectronicHorizonDataLoader</code></a>.
 The constructor accepts options to configure the data loader. For more information, see <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-segmentdataloaderoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapdata"><code>SegmentDataLoaderOptions</code></a>.
 The cache size limits the number of segments that the loader can keep in memory at the same time.</div>
<dl class="notes">
<dt>Parameters:</dt>
<dd><code>sdkEngine</code> - <p>The <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-sdknativeengine" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>SDKNativeEngine</code></a> instance that provides shared services, such as networking and map data.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>The <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-segmentdataloaderoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapdata"><code>SegmentDataLoaderOptions</code></a> instance that configures how segment data is requested.</dd>
<dd><code>segmentDataCacheSize</code> - <p>The maximum number of segments that the loader can cache.</dd>
<dt>Throws:</dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-instantiationerrorexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.errors">InstantiationErrorException</a></code> - <p><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-instantiationerrorexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.errors"><code>InstantiationErrorException</code></a> If the data loader cannot be created.</dd>
</dl>
</section>
